name: agentglass
description: Every AI coding agent on your machine, on one screen — live cost, tokens and tool calls across every provider, and a hold on anything dangerous until you say go. From your desk or your phone.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.desktop: cd web && bun run build && cd ../electron && bun run start
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('agentglass: run [bun run setup] to wire Claude Code hooks, [bun run connect] for OTel CLIs, [bun run connect:opencode] for OpenCode')"
